about: Guy Recording a Fight shows two people brawling on a patch of grass beside some metal bleachers, one with a fist raised high over the other, while a young man in a blue t-shirt lies comfortably on his stomach a few feet away, propped on his elbows, holding up his phone to film the whole thing. He is not intervening, not worried, just getting the best angle. The meme labels the fighters as two sides of an argument and the cameraman as the onlooker enjoying the drama from a perfect spot.
usage:
The top box usually describes the onlooker, often "me", and the bottom box describes the fight being filmed: two people, two companies, two fandoms. You can also treat the boxes as one sentence split across the image.

It suits any conflict you are watching with interest but no stake in: a comment section war, coworkers arguing in a meeting, two celebrities feuding, siblings fighting over the remote. The calmer and more comfortable the bystander sounds, the funnier the contrast with the chaos next to him.
ideas: watching two friends argue about pineapple pizza
watching two rival clubs' fans on twitter
watching the older two fight over the remote
